players.bio: André Filipe Cunha Vidigal (born 17 August 1998) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a left winger for EFL Championship side Stoke City.

Francisco Jorge Tavares Oliveira (born 5 February 2000), known as Chiquinho, is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a winger for Mallorca on loan from Premier League club Wolverhampton Wanderers.

Custódio Miguel Dias de Castro (born 24 May 1983), known simply as Custódio, is a Portuguese former professional footballer who played as a defensive midfielder, currently manager of Primeira Liga club Alverca.
João Vitor Brandão Figueiredo (born 27 May 1996) is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Turkish club İstanbul Başakşehir.
Goncalo Esteves is a football player from Portugal, defender for Alverca on loan from Udinese in the Italian Serie A.

Isaac James (born 28 August 2004) is a Nigerian professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Primeira Liga club Alverca. Career In November 2021, after having completed a trial at Danish club Midtjylland, James tried out at French club Lorient. In a friendly against Avranches, he was put in the opposing squad in order to even out the numbers.

Jhonatan Luiz da Siqueira (born 8 May 1991) is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Primeira Liga club Rio Ave. Club career Born in São Miguel do Oeste, Jhonatan joined the youth setup of Guarani at the age of fifteen. Two years later, he switched to the Joinville academy and was promoted to the senior team in 2010.

Lincoln Henrique Oliveira dos Santos (born 7 November 1998), commonly known as Lincoln or Lincoln Henrique, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or a winger for Primeira Liga club Alverca.
Marco Rachid Essimi Ateba (born 18 February 1999) is a Cameroonian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Ligue 2 club Rodez.
Matheus Mendes Werneck de Oliveira (born 10 March 1999) is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Primeira Liga club Alverca.
Matheus França de Oliveira (born 1 April 2004) is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or forward for Premier League club Crystal Palace.
Matheus Mendes Werneck de Oliveira (born 10 March 1999) is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Primeira Liga club Alverca.
Nabil Zoubdi Touaizi (born 1 February 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Spanish club Albacete Balompié. Born in Spain, he represents Morocco at under-20 level.
Ndemeni Bastien Chefren Meupiyou Menadjou (born 19 March 2006) is a French professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Portuguese Primeira Liga club Alverca.
Sabit Abdulai (born 11 May 1999) is a Ghanaian footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Primeira Liga club Alverca.
Sergi Gómez Solà (born 28 March 1992) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays for RCD Espanyol as a central defender.
Stéphane Diarra (born 9 December 1998) is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Ligue 2 club Lorient.

Steven Baseya (born 14 January 2005) is a French professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Portuguese Primeira Liga club Alverca. On 13 January 2023, Baseya made his senior debut for Nancy in a 1–1 draw against Le Puy in the Championnat National. At the end of the season, he left the club after deciding not to sign a professional contract.

Vivaldo Semedo is a 21-year-old professional footballer who plays as a centre-forward for EFL Championship club Watford F.C. and has just completed a loan move to Portuguese Primeira Liga side FC Alverca. Club career Semedo is a youth product of Povoense, and joined the youth academy of Sporting CP in 2018. On 6 May 2021, he signed his first professional contract with Sporting.
Yaya Bojang (born 10 September 2004) is a Gambian professional football player who plays as a centre-back for Danish Superliga club OB and The Gambia national team.
